newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see some sunmeal trades in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see some sunmeal trades in afternoon.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw some activity in Argentine sunmeal pellets this afternoon, while otherwise the higher dollar kept business restricted to a few nearby trades, market sources said.
"This morning we saw some trader covering nearby sunmeal and the ones who sold material rolled foreward their positions," one broker said.
Afloat Argentine sunmeal pellets traded at $155 a tonne cif Rotterdam, Dec at $160, Jan at $162 and Jan/March at $153.50 a tonne cif.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
